messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for taking the time to talk with me today about the enhancements to the student portal. To start off, could you tell me what your main goals are for improving the portal, especially regarding the personalised timetable management, grade notifications, and module feedback?

Hey! Thanks for having me. So, you know, the portal could just be a lot better, especially with the timetable. I just want it to be easier to read and use. Like, it’d be cool if I could colour-code my classes or hide the ones that are cancelled. I want to be able to add my own study times too, you know? 

And then there’s grades. I really want to know when my grades are out without having to check all the time. A little notification would be awesome!

Oh, and feedback on modules would be nice too. It’d be great to have a way to share what I think about the modules after the semester ends. Just so the teachers can see how things are going.

Thanks for sharing that! It sounds like you have some great ideas. So, just to clarify on the timetable, you mentioned wanting to colour-code your classes and hide cancelled ones. Can you tell me a bit more about how you envision the colour-coding working? Like, what colors would you want to use, and how would you decide which classes get which colors?

Oh, um, I haven't really thought about specific colours, to be honest. I guess I’d just want it to be something that makes sense for me, like maybe using different colours for different subjects or types of classes. You know, like lectures in one colour and tutorials in another? Just something that helps me see it all at a glance without having to think too hard about it. 

And hiding cancelled classes would just make the whole thing cleaner, you know? I just want it to be less cluttered. But I don’t know, I guess whatever works best!

Got it! So you’d like to use different colours for different subjects, like lectures and tutorials, to make it easier to read. And hiding cancelled classes would help reduce clutter on your timetable. 

Now, regarding the grade notifications, you mentioned that you'd like to know when your grades are out. How do you imagine this notification system working? Would you prefer an email, a pop-up on the portal, or maybe a mobile app notification?

Yeah, exactly! So for the grade notifications, I think a pop-up on the portal would be great, like just a quick alert when something new is posted. But honestly, I wouldn’t mind getting an email about it either. Just something that makes it clear that there’s a new grade, you know? I just want to be sure I don’t miss it! A mobile app notification could be cool too, but I don’t really use the app much. Just as long as I get the heads-up, that’s what matters!

Thanks for clarifying that! So you’d like a pop-up alert on the portal for new grades, and getting an email notification would be a good backup option too. It’s great to know that you want to ensure you don’t miss any updates.

Now, for the module feedback system you mentioned, can you give me an example of what kind of feedback you'd like to provide? Like, would you want to rate the module, write comments, or maybe both?

Oh, I definitely think both would be helpful. I’d like to rate the module on things like how the content was and how well it was taught. And then, I’d want to add comments for more detail, you know? Like if there was something I really liked or something that could be improved. Just a way to share what worked and what didn’t, so they know how to make things better for next time!

That sounds really useful! So for the module feedback, you’d like a rating system for aspects like content and teaching quality, plus the option to add detailed comments about what you liked or what could be improved. 

Just to wrap things up, are there any limitations or restrictions we should be aware of while implementing these features? Like, any technical constraints or things that must be considered?

Um, I haven’t really thought about any technical stuff or limitations. I just know what I want from my experience using the portal. I guess I just hope it all works smoothly and doesn’t take too long to load or anything. But as for specific constraints, I’m not sure what those would be. I’m more focused on how the features can actually help us students!

That’s totally understandable! So you’re primarily focused on the user experience and want the new features to work smoothly without long loading times. 

To summarize what we've gathered so far:

1. Personalised timetable management with colour-coding for different subjects and the ability to hide cancelled classes for a cleaner view.
2. A notification system for grade updates that includes a pop-up alert on the portal and optional email notifications.
3. A structured module feedback system that allows students to rate modules and provide detailed comments about their experience.

I think we’ve got a solid understanding of the requirements!
